supersedes: D004_decision_protocol_v3 (seasonA onwards; v3 never governed a decision)
t2_inputs: exactly the frozen dossier.json (pipeline/dossier.py): every item published before gate captured_et; the gate and factor items carry captured_et itself
t2_call: pipeline/t2_stage2.py on the Actions runner only: a leak-probe call with nothing in context, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; claude -p --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources '' --disable-slash-commands --tools '' --max-turns 1 --system-prompt, scratch cwd; the CLI init line must show no tools and no MCP servers, the result one turn and no server tool use; auth CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
t2_order: earliest deadline first, then sha256('<season>|<TICKER>|<date>') ascending; no frozen t2.json by the deadline = T2 MISSING

t2g.status: SHADOW - never scored as T2, never in a confirmatory family
t2g.call: Gemini API generateContent, same system prompt and dossier, no tools, no grounding; GEMINI_API_KEY
t2g.on_503_or_429: a usage limit: this run stops for T2G, a later run retries; not a failed attempt

freeze: stage 1 (snapshot day): gate, factors, option chain, dossier, T0, T1, decision.json with t2.stage2; stage 2: t2.json + t2_thesis.md + manifest_t2.json + RFC 3161 tokens, committed before the entry open
t1: code only: pipeline/t1_rule.py decide() on factors.json H1..H10 with registry/T1_rule_v0.json, written by freeze.py
decision_by_code: BUY iff round(confidence, 2) > 0.50; the model only estimates

t2e.rule: mean of T2 and T2G confidence where both were frozen before the entry open; BUY iff > 0.50
